items.title: Melodía
items.shortDesc: A highly advanced, full-stack music streaming platform engineered with a seamless UI and groundbreaking AI capabilities.
items.fullDesc: An ambitious, full-stack recreation of Spotify that matches its core streaming infrastructure while introducing two disruptive features. It boasts an advanced audio-recognition engine (Shazam-style) capable of identifying tracks via humming or ambient playback. Furthermore, it integrates a real-time 'AI Cover' engine, allowing users to seamlessly map any artist's vocal model onto any track—effortlessly engineering crossovers like Michael Jackson performing a Queen anthem.

items.title: VibeTrip
items.shortDesc: A comprehensive, full-stack travel discovery ecosystem modeled after TripAdvisor.
items.fullDesc: A collaborative full-stack web platform for trip planning and discovery. It combines a robust asynchronous backend with a modern, high-performance frontend featuring interactive maps (Leaflet), analytics dashboards (ECharts) and full media management. Built as a team, applying CI/CD with GitHub Actions for automated testing, database migration validation and VPS deployment.

items.title: Cassandra Engine
items.shortDesc: A high-performance, distributed Cassandra database engine engineered entirely from scratch in Rust.
items.fullDesc: A from-scratch Rust implementation of an Apache Cassandra-style distributed database, over 18,400 lines of code. It features a native CQL parser, token partitioning via Murmur3, Gossip-based discovery, hinted handoff and read repair. It ships with a graphical flight simulation app that demonstrates concurrent reads under different consistency levels (QUORUM/ONE) over TLS.

items.title: Money Laundering Analysis
items.shortDesc: A fault-tolerant distributed pipeline for analysing massive bank statements in parallel.
items.fullDesc: A fault-tolerant distributed pipeline built to ingest and analyse massive bank statements in parallel. It implements the Bully algorithm for leader election and guarantees exactly-once processing semantics through atomic checkpoints and sequence-number deduplication. It scales dynamically through hash-partitioned routing over RabbitMQ, recovering from node failures automatically without losing state.

items.title: SpecForge
items.shortDesc: An AI-driven CLI platform for automated Property-Based Testing (PBT) and API vulnerability detection.
items.fullDesc: My degree thesis: a sophisticated CLI platform designed for language-agnostic Property-Based Testing (PBT) of APIs. It integrates large language models (LLMs) with advanced Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parsing and deep code logic extraction. By leveraging a proprietary schema synthesis engine, SpecForge autonomously generates comprehensive test suites to expose edge cases, unearth security vulnerabilities, and stress-test volume limits across any API endpoint.

items.title: Predictive Models & AI Analysis
items.shortDesc: A suite of advanced machine learning models for predictive analytics, clustering, and NLP sentiment classification.
items.fullDesc: A comprehensive Machine Learning and NLP portfolio applied to five complex datasets. It spans big-data ingestion and multivariate anomaly detection with Isolation Forest through to ensemble classifiers (XGBoost, Random Forest, Stacking). It is anchored by a sentiment analysis pipeline that evaluates everything from logistic regression over TF-IDF to Bi-LSTM neural networks in Keras, handling negation and lemmatisation in Spanish.

items.title: Monopoly Game Engine
items.shortDesc: A fully functional Monopoly game engine built from scratch in Java, featuring complex state management and custom UI themes.
items.fullDesc: An interactive desktop simulator built on an object-oriented architecture with strict MVC separation. The engine decouples model logic from the graphical interface, letting the board, rules and characters be configured entirely through external files without touching core code. It implements advanced design patterns such as Abstract Factory for dynamic management of player actions.

items.title: Zorro y Ocas (Assembly)
items.shortDesc: A logic-based terminal game programmed strictly in Assembly language to master CPU architecture and memory management.
items.fullDesc: A classic strategy game engine developed entirely in x86-64 Assembly (Intel syntax) for Linux. Written in strict accordance with the System V AMD64 calling convention, which allows it to link directly against a driver of 55 automated unit tests written in C. It implements efficient terminal rendering with support for ANSI escape sequences and UTF-8 characters and emoji.
